intelligence.human_view: Four laws, one bar. First — one bar, everywhere: the plus on the right and left and the old icons are not a different bar, they are Personal's bar, mirrored — the same six tiles, same glyphs, same colors, same order, on every page. Second — it gets out of the way: when you scroll, it folds down, and he likes it that way — the page is for reading, the bar waits until you stop. Third — the light lives inside the icon: the notification lights up, but with white in the middle where the icon is, so it pops more — and it stays bright, it comes on bright like that, for each of them. One icon that lights up, never an icon beside its own light. Fourth — the bar is the door to the day: tap any tile and you go to the Calendar, actually inside, for that day — for each of these — and there you see your stats, and you see your notifications. The day is the unit, and the bottom bar is how you get there. Note honestly: the greeting-out round had already made the Dashboard bar byte-identical to Personal's, and the captain's eye confirmed the six tiles at 1920 — so the "mirror Personal" part may already be satisfied in the staged build. The new, unbuilt parts are the fold-down, the white-center notification, and the tap-to-Calendar-for-the-day. The loop records the teaching; the captain adjudicates what the staged bytes already satisfy.
intelligence.simple_view: The bar at the bottom — the buttons you tap all the time — should look exactly like the one on your Personal page, on every page! And when you scroll down, it folds away so you can read. And when you have a message, the little light on the button shines bright with white right in the middle, so it pops! And when you tap a button, it takes you right into your Calendar for today — and there you can see all your numbers and all your messages!
